reviews.pros: My experience at Maersk was highly positive due to the company's strong emphasis on collaboration, learning, and global exposure. I appreciated the supportive team culture, where open communication and mutual respect were encouraged across all levels. Additionally, Maersk's focus on continuous improvement and digital transformation gave me the opportunity to work on innovative projects and develop professionally. The leadership was approachable and invested in employee growth, which made me feel valued and motivated. Overall, the dynamic and inclusive environment at Maersk made it a great place to learn and contribute
reviews.cons: While my overall experience at Maersk was very positive, one area I found challenging was the complexity of internal processes. Being such a large, global organization, certain decisions or implementations could take longer due to multiple layers of approval and coordination across regions. While I understand this comes with the scale of the company, at times it impacted agility. That said, I also recognize that Maersk is actively working on streamlining operations and improving efficiency, which is encouraging.
